name: Umar
contribution: The second Rashidun caliph, ruling from August 634 until his assassination in 644.
legacy: His campaigns against the Sasanian Empire resulted in the rapid conquest of Persia within two years, and more than two-thirds of the Byzantine Empire.

checks.lead: Umar ibn al-Khattab (Arabic: عُمَر بْن ٱلْخَطَّاب, romanized: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb; c. 584 CE – 6 November 644 CE) was the second Rashidun caliph, ruling from August 634 until his assassination in 644. He succeeded Abu Bakr (r. 632–634) and is regarded as a senior companion and father-in-law of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
